sloka: द्रक्ष्यन्ति तु अद्य दैवस्य पौरुषम् पुरुषस्य च ।दैव मानुषयोः अद्य व्यक्ता व्यक्तिर् भविष्यति ॥२-२३-१८॥
transliteration: drakṣyanti tu adya daivasya pauruṣam puruṣasya ca ।daiva mānuṣayoḥ adya vyaktā vyaktir bhaviṣyati ॥2-23-18॥

translations.english: Today all will witness the power of destiny and the power of man. The difference between man and destiny will be manifested today.
